column1: # Engine split (photocraft#15710): the crate each engine module goes to. A unit is a module of
# crates/engine-core/src: `cmd/<name>` for one declared in cmd.rs, `<name>` for one declared in lib.rs.
# Its files are the module's file and every file its `mod` declarations reach. scripts/engine_split/engine_cut.py reads it. A module not listed stays in core.
